commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Make Obeka connect with actual player combat damage and turn that many postcombat additional upkeep steps into Courts, Treasure/Clues and artifact conversions with Time Sieve; support first-hit damage and paid extra combats.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 — Optimized: real player-damage connections, five-mana follow-ups and upkeep engines can create powerful snowball lines, but not a compact reliable cEDH goldfish.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Protect commander-damage extra-upkeep identity and Court/Smaug/Sieve conversion; reject unrelated Consultation or Breach shells and generic fast-combo replacements.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 original noncommander slots were considered against retained Court, Smaug, Journal, upkeep-counter, combat, protection, token and Time Sieve roles. Six selected redundant/slower slots, two additional held incumbents, and six external challenger cards were individually judged.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 35 lands remain physically identical, including Island x3, Mountain x2 and Swamp x2; UBR identity and legalities all pass fresh 96-identity Scryfall snapshot. Rogue's Passage was rejected to avoid trading one Swamp for four-mana evasion; selected changes are red or colorless.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Obeka still has menace, haste/evade sources, equipment/protection and existing interactive spells. Karlach, Jeska, Assault and Manufactor require board survival, two legal attackers or mana, and opponent priority can disrupt every modeled repeat.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: The additional Protection Racket, nonlegend clone Auras, single-use power/double strike, and Rogue's Passage land challenge were examined directly, not selected by popularity or swap quota.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Rejected because opposing choice and target Aura exposure combined with loss of resilient replication and commander protection; it can compound upkeeps but is fragile.
Rejected because first-hit burst requires casting a vulnerable instant and paying four land-based evasion mana while weakening black sources and durable protection.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Considered sacrificing Replication for enchantment clone or Passage for Swamp, and Ring of Evos Isle for combat tricks; each costs more durable board/black pip support than it adds.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The baseline may underpressure initial commander damage and leave many payoffs inert if Obeka never connects; high-lift upkeep payoffs alone do not fix access.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Jeska, Blackblade, Rising and Karlach increase first contact or additional real combat events; Academy Manufactor and Aggravated Assault convert actual upkeep assets without weakening 35-land base.

owner_authority.owner_approval_question: This deck is complete. Do you approve it?

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: The historical complete 99-slot audit plus fresh challenge kept Courts, Smaug, Journal, Time Sieve, protection, the 35-land source base, pressure equipment and upkeep conversion. The six actual cuts lost to first-hit output and extra combats; additional retained Replication, Ring of Evos Isle and Swamp were challenged without manufacturing a weak cut.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Aura could make token copies every upkeep, but target exposure and the legend rule on Smaug reduce reliability versus a flexible non-Aura Replication engine.
Land unblockability competes with four mana and a lost black source; existing Aqueous Form, Brotherhood Regalia, Shizo and menace protection offer better first-hit pressure.

open_ended_optimization_audit.no_credible_larger_package_reason: Both seventh/eighth-slot challenges were evaluated after the six positive exchanges: losing Extravagant Replication for Followed Footsteps makes targeted Aura and legendary Smaug risks worse, and losing Swamp for Rogue's Passage costs a black source plus four activation mana each combat. Unleash Fury and Protection Racket similarly exchange permanent protection or clone flexibility for timing-vulnerable burst/opponent-controlled outcomes. Two distinct higher-count conceptual portfolios were rejected and are recorded in the heightened audit; no extra full-100 package improves role balance enough to stage as a winner.
open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: The stop is based on the net role tradeoff, not having reached six swaps. The selected package improves early Obeka player-damage output, haste and payable repeated combat while preserving all 35 lands and original Court/Smaug/Journal/Time Sieve engines. After challenging held Replication, Ring of Evos Isle, Swamp, Protection Racket, aura clones, combat tricks and Rogue's Passage, every extra trade loses black mana, durable protection, flexible copying, or relies on opposing decisions/fragile timing. No unexecuted win-rate claim is used.
